units.source_text: 可是，话又说回来，这种古老的“叮当电车”保留至今还使用，也许有古都的风味吧。

en.t: But then again, the fact that this old-fashioned clanging streetcar has survived and is still in use may be part of the flavor of the ancient capital.

units.source_text: 车身当然很小，对坐席位，窄得几乎膝盖碰膝盖。

en.t: The car itself is of course very small, and the facing seats are so narrow that passengers' knees almost touch.
